searchText: Hi there, does anyone know anything about why Holesky stopped finalizing about 1hr ago? A couple of operators were updating and it happened at the same-ish time and it took the participation rate down. It should be done now and finalizing. We also found a few nodes down on our end, we're fixing it now and it should improve the participation rate some more. Hey guys, can you help me to fast-track this process . It would be really helpful 🙏 https://github.com/ethpandaops/fundingvault/issues/103
